chunks: From him, from Ibn Maḥbūb, from Nuʿaym ibn Ibrāhīm, from Abī Sayyār Mismāʿ, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, concerning:

Concerning four who testified against a woman for indecency, one of whom was her husband, he said: “The three are flogged, and her husband performs liʿān with her, and they are separated, and she is never lawful for him again.”

key_terms.تَحِلُّ: be lawful or permissible in marriage
key_terms.يُجْلَدُونَ: they are flogged as a legal punishment
key_terms.يُلَاعِنُهَا: he invokes mutual imprecation with her through liʿān
key_terms.ٱمْرَأَةٍ: a woman, the accused female party in the ruling

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a husband is one of four witnesses accusing his wife of indecency?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a case in which four testify against a woman for indecency, while one of the four is her husband. It states that the husband does not count as an ordinary witness in the same way as the other three; rather, the three are punished, and the husband proceeds through liʿān, after which the spouses are permanently separated.
